title: Buy low, sell high
goal: Learn what profit and loss mean.

slides.text: You buy a toy for $5. Then you sell it for $8. You got $3 more than you paid.
slides.title: A toy story

slides.text: That $3 is your profit. Profit is money you make when you sell for more than you paid.
slides.title: Profit

slides.text: Say you sell the toy for $3. You paid $5, so you lose $2. That is called a loss.
slides.title: Loss

slides.text: One buy or one sell is called a trade. A person who buys and sells stocks is a trader.
slides.title: Trades

slides.text: Stock prices go up and down. A trader can make a profit or have a loss.
slides.title: Both ways

questions.prompt: You buy at $10 and sell at $12. What do you have?
questions.explanation: $12 is more than $10, so you made $2. That is a profit.

questions.prompt: You buy at $10 and sell at $7. What do you have?
questions.explanation: $7 is less than $10, so you lost $3. That is a loss.

questions.prompt: A trade is one buy or one sell.
questions.explanation: Yes. One buy or one sell is one trade.
Profit is the sell price minus the buy price.

questions.prompt: Match each word to its meaning.

pairs.definition: Money you make when you sell for more
Money you lose when you sell for less
A person who buys and sells stocks

questions.explanation: Profit is a gain. Loss is a drop. A trade is one buy or sell.

questions.prompt: You always make a profit when you trade.
questions.explanation: No. You can make a profit or a loss. Most day traders lose money.
